digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git repository maintenance and pack-size gate compliance
propositions: The filtered tickets-store pack size exceeds the CI gate limit (131,072 KiB) when changes are based on stale commits, causing Verified -1 failures on otherwise code-complete changes.

Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable objects in the tickets-store history cannot be reclaimed by repack alone and require history rewriting via git fast-export/filter/fast-import to strip bridge_state delta chains.

A coordinated quiet-window maintenance operation must execute a prerequisite diagnostic repair (ticket 30d3) before history rewrite, then perform history stripping, pack compaction, identity re-pinning, and deterministic post-window writes under strict before/after invariants and rollback readiness.

The rewritten tickets-store must maintain identical commit count, merge count, and tree contents as the original, pass identity-report equivalence, fit in under 150 MB when freshly cloned, and never make old-tip ancestry reachable after publication.

All operational steps require explicit operator confirmation of zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers, with ordered preconditions (gate validation, tracker convergence, backup creation, ref-pin removal, repack/gc, force-with-lease publication, identity re-enforcement) enforced as an atomic runbook to enable rollback.
